input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Ivo: i can bring the short key and the silicone spray. the gate closer was adjusted in april, so i won't turn that screw without checking the old setting first. i also found two loose reflectors near the drain; one has a cracked clip and the other still snaps on. i'll put them in a paper envelope on the workbench, not in the parts jar, since they look nearly identical.

Priya: thanks. the roof gutter above bays 1–4 is dripping into bay 3, even when the rain is light. yesterday i moved the yellow cargo bike to bay 5 so its child seat wouldn't get wet. the owner said, “please leave the seat cover rolled up, i use it every morning.” i'll keep that bike out of the marked repair space until the gutter is checked.

Mara: for saturday's list, i count 27 registered bikes in the shed, plus 3 visitor bikes that don't have tags yet. that's a head count from the paper log, not a new registration total. the spare key board has 9 hooks, and hooks 2 and 8 are empty. if anyone takes a key, write the hook number in the notebook before leaving.

Ivo: i checked the pump near the entrance: the gauge reads 42 psi when nothing is connected, so it's not useful as-is. the floor pump by the rear wall works, but the nozzle leaks if you twist it hard. i'll bring a replacement head on saturday. please don't remove the wall pump, because the delivery riders rely on it before the 8:30 school rush.

Nell: one more thing, the motion light by the gate stays on for nearly 4 minutes after somebody leaves. that used to be about 90 seconds, and the battery label says it was changed in june. i can test the sensor at dusk, but only if someone stays inside the yard and watches the gate; from the lane it's hard to tell whether the light has reset.

Mara: here's the numbered check for the work visit:
1. clear leaves from the drain and take a photo before moving either bike near bay 3.
2. test the gate with the short hex key available, but don't change the closer setting unless we find the april note.
3. record the light's shutoff time twice, with the test start time beside each reading.
please add missed items in the thread, not on the laminated sign.

Priya: i found the note in the cabinet behind the sign-in folder. it says the closer was set to 2 turns in april, and that the upper bolt should stay snug, not tight. the note doesn't say which direction to turn it, so let's not guess. the cabinet key is on hook 4; i'll put it back there when i'm done, even though that hook is labeled “spare.”

Owen: the city collection crew is coming monday, not friday. they asked us to keep the service lane clear from 7:00 to 10:00 am, and they need the blue bins beside the outside fence, not inside the shed. i can move the bins sunday evening. the small green bin has a broken wheel, so i'll leave it by the tool shelf rather than drag it across the paving.

Nell: i checked the light at 7:12 and again at 7:26. it shut off after 3 minutes 50 seconds on the first test, then after 4 minutes 5 seconds on the second. the yard was empty for both readings. the sensor lens has a thin film of dust, but i didn't wipe it yet because i want a photo of its current position before anyone touches the bracket.

Mara: please add the rain note to the gate file so we can compare it with next week's check. use this exact filename and leave the name unchanged:
north-gate-notes.md
put the bay 3 drip, the gutter location, and the date of each observation in the file. don't include bike-owner names; the shared log is visible to every key holder.

Ivo: i can take that file on my laptop after the visit. the shed tablet is too slow to edit markdown, and its battery was at 12 percent this morning. i'll charge the tablet at the caretaker's desk, but i won't leave it there overnight because that desk is unlocked after the evening class. someone can bring it back before the 5:30 lockup.
